therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-1 checkpoint inhibition combined with DNA hypomethylation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced T-cell activation against leukemic cells through checkpoint blockade and epigenetic reprogramming
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Relapsed/refractory AML patients and newly diagnosed older AML patients not eligible for intensive chemotherapy

results.dose_information: Pembrolizumab 200 mg intravenous, azacitidine intravenous or subcutaneous, 28-day cycles
